query_analysis.original_query: I am facing challenges in maintaining a steady pH in the alkaline solvent circulation of a Desulphurization tower. Our controller tuning seems off. Can you guide us on improving the PID settings?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Assist in diagnosing and optimizing the PID controller settings to stabilize pH levels in the alkaline solvent circulation system of a Desulphurization tower, as current controller tuning seems ineffective.

selected_agents.role: Identify process disturbances affecting pH control
Provide process insights and operational requirements

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collaborative analysis of control system and process factors affecting pH stability
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated tuning and troubleshooting with continuous feedback

clarification_questions: What are the current PID controller settings for the pH control loop?
Have there been any recent changes in process conditions or solvent composition?
Can you provide historical data on pH fluctuations and controller responses?
